replies.body:
The only problem I have with each person getting one protected bench is that 6 people defending could each place their indestructible crafting table on each side of the monument till it is completely surrounded.

I think to prevent this, the "protection spell" should only be effective outside a certain size radius from the monument. That way they can't arrange an unfair defense.
